human_review_status: Strictly automated synthetic ground truth; zero external human clinician annotations

patient_and_clinical_data_overlap.notes: Untouched cohort uses novel patient names (e.g. Devika Menon, Farhan Qureshi) and April 2026 dates.

template_and_canvas_overlap.notes: Both cohorts render using the same PIL and PyMuPDF drawing logic and header banner geometry.

sources_of_variation: Varying row counts and analyte combinations
Different text string lengths causing variable horizontal line flow
Gaussian blur and multi-level noise scatter

formal_evaluation_declaration: Because canvas templates and rendering functions are shared with the historical generator, template independence is NOT established. This benchmark must be strictly cited as an 'unseen synthetic-document evaluation', NOT an out-of-distribution or unseen-template evaluation.
